csv_project_name: Design & CA for Midcrown Multi-Generational Center and Park
csv_scope_of_work: The City of San Antonio (City), Capital Delivery Department (CDD) is issuing a Request for Qualifications (RFQ) seeking Statement of Qualifications (SOQ) from interested professional architectural firms (Respondents) for the design and construction administration services for the Midcrown Multi-Generation Center and Park .The scope of work includes programming and design for a 16,000 SF Multi-generation Community Center and associated site development. The community center will provide programs to be determined during the facility design process and will be managed by the Department of Human Services (DHS), the Parks and Recreation Department, and or a combination of the two.
